categories.main_business_segments: United Renewable Energy Co., Ltd. primarily operates in solar photovoltaic manufacturing, including solar cells and modules, as well as solar power system development, construction, and asset management services. The company also engages in energy storage systems and related renewable energy solutions, covering upstream manufacturing to downstream system integration and maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced photovoltaic technologies such as monocrystalline P-type and N-type solar cells, including M10 PERC and TOPCon cells. It has developed bifacial double-glass modules with high wind and salt resistance, and is pioneering next-generation technologies like perovskite silicon stacked modules and easy-disassembled solar modules for recycling. Manufacturing processes emphasize high conversion efficiency, durability, and environmental sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: URECO serves a diverse customer base including utility-scale solar power plants, industrial and commercial rooftop installations, residential solar systems, and specialized applications like fishery and agriculture symbiosis projects. Major markets include Taiwan, the United States, Europe, Southeast Asia, and emerging markets in Central and South America and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing plants and headquarters located there, and has subsidiaries and plants in Thailand and other international locations. Its sales and project development extend globally, with significant presence in the U.S., Europe, Southeast Asia, and expanding into Central and South America and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: URECO operates across the solar energy supply chain, including upstream manufacturing of solar cells and modules, midstream product assembly, and downstream system development, construction, and maintenance services. It also engages in energy storage solutions, positioning itself as a vertically integrated renewable energy solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on R&D to improve photovoltaic conversion efficiency, develop high-reliability and high-wattage solar modules, and innovate in next-generation technologies such as TOPCon cells, perovskite silicon stacking, and easy-disassembled modules for recycling. It emphasizes product durability for harsh environments and integrates energy storage to enhance grid stability. Strategic alliances and patent development support its innovation pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: URECO generates revenue primarily through the sale of solar cells, modules, and complete solar power generation systems. It also earns income from system development, construction contracts, asset management services, and energy storage solutions. The company engages in project development and sells developed projects to asset management firms, creating a diversified revenue stream.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: URECO is positioned as one of the largest and most comprehensive solar energy companies in Taiwan, recognized as a Tier 1 module manufacturer by Bloomberg New Energy Finance. It competes globally with major solar manufacturers, particularly facing competition from large Chinese manufacturers. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, product reliability, and integrated system solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, URECO reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$5.8 billion, a 54% decrease from 2023, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about NT$2.13 billion. Despite recent losses due to market challenges, the company maintains a strong cash position of around NT$6.78 billion and continues to invest in R&D and global expansion. It operates a sizable production capacity with 876MW cell and 830MW module installed capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: URECO emphasizes high-efficiency, high-reliability, and environmentally sustainable solar products tailored for diverse environments, including harsh coastal and typhoon-prone areas. Its bifacial and double-glass modules offer superior power generation and durability. The company also leads in developing recyclable, easy-to-disassemble modules, supporting circular economy goals. Its vertically integrated business model and comprehensive system services provide customers with one-stop renewable energy solutions.
